findings.minimal_treatment: Add the distinct-block condition in the target and disclose it.

findings.source_issue: The displayed sentence universally quantifies x in the claim that every y equals 2x or 2x+1. This is false; division by two says for each y there exists such an x. The subsequent argument also uses existence.
findings.minimal_treatment: Replace the inner universal quantifier by an existential quantifier and disclose the repair.
